title: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR of one date is the same date a year earlier
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 2, 15 ) )

source.quote: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR returns the selected period shifted back one year.
Internally SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR corresponds to the following call of DATEADD :

derivation: 2024-02-15 moves back one year to 2023-02-15. Sales on that date: 30.
